definitions.gloss: to get through, to overcome, to survive
definitions.explanation: To successfully endure and get past a difficult situation, crisis, or challenging period.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乗|の}り{切|き}ろう。
⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{乗|の}り{切|き}った。
examples.english: We somehow got through the harsh winter.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}して→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧、⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧な⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乗|の}り{切|き}ること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: By cooperating as a whole team, we were able to get through the difficult period.

notes:
CONJUGATION: {乗|の}り{切|き}る is a godan verb. Te-form: {乗|の}り{切|き}って. Potential: {乗|の}り{切|き}れる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乗|の}り{切|き}る (to overcome a crisis)
- ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乗|の}り{切|き}る (to get through difficulties)
- ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乗|の}り{切|き}る (to survive the summer)
- ⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{乗|の}り{切|き}る (to weather a recession)

This is a compound verb formed from ⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ (to ride) + ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to complete). The ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ component adds the nuance of "completely" or "all the way through."
